title: Access and Identity Standard
content: Access requests must be approved by the requester's manager. Standard access requests should be completed within one business day after approval. When a worker leaves the organisation, their accounts must be disabled within 4 hours of the confirmed departure time. Access to confidential documents must not be shared with external parties without written approval from the information owner.

title: Incident Handling Runbook
content: For a Severity 1 incident, the on-call responder must notify the incident commander within 15 minutes of confirmation. The incident commander coordinates response ownership. During an active Severity 1 incident, status updates must be recorded every 30 minutes. An incident may be closed only after service recovery has been validated and the incident record contains a closure summary.

title: Project Handover Checklist
content: A project handover must include the current project status, named owner, open risks, outstanding decisions, key documents, and next milestone. The receiving owner must acknowledge the handover before the project is marked as transferred. Any unresolved high-priority risk must have a named action owner and target date.

title: Expense Reimbursement Guide
content: Employees should submit reimbursement claims within 10 calendar days of the expense. An itemised receipt is required for each claim. Expenses above INR 25,000 require department-head approval before reimbursement. The guide does not specify a monetary penalty for late submissions.

title: Data Lifecycle Standard
content: Working files should be reviewed at least once every 12 months. Records subject to a legal hold must not be deleted. When a record reaches its approved retention end date and no legal hold applies, the data owner must authorise deletion. Deletion activity must be recorded in the data register.

title: Change Control Procedure
content: A standard production change requires a documented change request, an impact assessment, a rollback plan, and approval from the designated change owner. Emergency changes may proceed before the full review, but the change record must be completed within one business day after implementation.

title: Research Quality Note
content: Research summaries must distinguish observed evidence from interpretation. Every material factual claim should have a traceable source. Where evidence is incomplete or conflicting, the author should state the limitation rather than infer a definitive conclusion.

title: Service Request Guide
content: A service request should include a clear description, the affected service, a contact person, and the desired completion date. Requests that cannot be completed as submitted should be returned with the missing information identified. A request is complete only after the requester confirms the outcome.
